test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Geet and Anshuman are children of Aditya's mother's brother. Roop has only one brother, Manjeet and no sisters.

 

Ayushman is Rajkumar's son. Ayushman is the father of Manjeet. Roop's husband and Manjeet's wife do not have brothers or sisters. If Aditya is the son of Roop, how is Manjeet related to Geet?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

**Given:**

1) Aditya is the son of Roop.

2) Roop has only one brother, Manjeet and no sisters.

3) Roop's husband and Manjeet's wife do not have brothers or sisters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d527c7de27cec16b6b28ba056346b51a009662f1e7afff55a92f1ef569c2c78e.png] 

4) Geet and Anshuman are children of Aditya's mother's brother.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38e1f9e3cc68e15fa60fc9fbca2b807854e6d94ce37c3edec6da4e5ef7153eb7.png] 

5) Ayushman is the father of Manjeet.

6) Ayushman is Rajkumar's son.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b76b6c4b279e077c1945696d1cdf737d416ab7fd71a203678b7844ede60375a0.png] 

Thus, Manjeet is Geet's father.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**Ayushman and Anshuman are two different persons.

Ayushman is the paternal grandfather of Anshuman.
